short: The final major offensive of the European theatre, culminating in the Soviet capture of the German capital and the end of the Nazi regime.
full:
On 16 April 1945, the Red Army launched a massive assault across the Oder and Neisse rivers, bearing down on Berlin with overwhelming superiority in men and artillery. After breaking through the fierce German defences at the Seelow Heights, Soviet forces completely encircled the city. The ensuing urban combat was extraordinarily brutal, fought street-by-street against regular German soldiers, SS units, and desperate civilian militias.

As Soviet troops fought their way toward the Reichstag and the city centre, Adolf Hitler committed suicide in his bunker on 30 April. The city's remaining garrison surrendered on 2 May. The fall of Berlin effectively destroyed the last remnants of the German military command, leading directly to the unconditional surrender of all German armed forces less than a week later.
